derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of (to roast or parch;
def: akin to the base of G5395 (φλόξ)); something desiccated, i.e. a dry twig

occurrences.text: And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks, and laid them on the fire, there came a viper out of the heat, and fastened on his hand.
